**Author**: Erik Broekhuizen
**Published Date**: 2015-01-01

Whatever Floats Your Boat
8 May 2015: Floating storage appears to be picking up. Ever since the dramatic decline in oil prices, which started in the second half of 2014, charterers and ship owners alike have been eyeing the forward oil market.
